system.description:
The Salubri gains insight into a target by touching or tasting a sample of the target's own spilled blood. If the target has left a blood trail, the warrior may track him by it.

System: The Salubri takes a little of the target's blood onto fingers or tongue and concentrates. The player rolls Perception + Awareness (difficulty 6). Each success reveals a single piece of information about the target, such as generation, clan, occupation, age, or whether the target is a diablerist — though the information is never entirely straightforward, and the Beast may react to "stimulants" in the blood. Tasting the blood (rather than merely touching it) lowers the difficulty of all rolls related to this power by 1. If the blood is from an animal, the Salubri may be briefly assaulted with the animal's heightened senses. To track prey by a blood trail, the player rolls Perception + Survival (difficulty 6); successes indicate how many scenes the trail can be followed before a reroll is needed. For every generation of the target's blood higher than 8th, the difficulty of the base roll drops by one.

This is a power of the ritual of the blooding, available only to warriors who have undergone an accurate blooding per the Code of Samiel. It may be purchased for 7 experience points by those who qualify.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
system.prerequisites: Blooding by the Code of Samiel
